project.title: Launch of Data-Driven SME Advisory Service
project.objective: Design and launch a data-driven advisory service for SME clients, combining financial insights, business intelligence, and integrated communication.
deliverables: Standard SME financial and BI assessment framework
Pricing and packaging model for the advisory service
Marketing and PR launch plan with key messages
Pilot client report template and dashboard specification
Operational playbook for consultants and support teams
constraints: Service must be launch-ready within 30 days
All materials must comply with financial and advertising regulations
Use only existing BI and reporting tools approved by IT
Budget for external media spend is capped and pre-approved
Client data usage must follow internal data protection policies

risks.risk: Service scope becomes too broad and hard to deliver consistently.
risks.mitigation: Define clear inclusion/exclusion criteria and standard assessment steps in the playbook.

risks.risk: Regulatory issues with financial advice and promotional claims.
risks.mitigation: Early legal review of assessment framework, pricing, and all external messaging.

risks.risk: Low adoption by sales and consultants due to complexity.
risks.mitigation: Co-create workflows with end users and run a short enablement session before launch.

risks.risk: Data quality issues impacting BI insights for SME clients.
risks.mitigation: Define minimum data requirements and validation checks in the assessment framework.

themes.why_relevant: Aligns all roles on what the SME advisory service includes and how it creates value.
Ensures consistent, auditable analysis across clients and consultants.
Balances client affordability with sustainable margins and budget limits.
Drives awareness and trust in the new service among SME prospects.
Reduces regulatory and reputational risk when using client financial data.
Uses early client and internal feedback to refine the service before scaling.

backlog.task: Define SME advisory service scope, target segments, and value proposition
definition_of_done: Service concept document drafted and shared
Target SME profiles and use cases listed
Key value statements agreed with stakeholders

backlog.task: Design standard financial and BI assessment framework for SME clients
definition_of_done: Checklist of required financial statements and KPIs created
Risk and performance indicators defined and documented
Reviewed and validated by business intelligence manager

backlog.task: Specify BI dashboards and reporting views to support the advisory service
definition_of_done: List of required data sources and metrics documented
Wireframes or mockups of dashboards created
Feasibility confirmed with IT and data platform owner

backlog.task: Develop pricing and packaging options for the SME advisory service
definition_of_done: At least three pricing tiers with inclusions defined
Profitability assumptions documented with accountant input
Pricing proposal approved by senior management

backlog.task: Create core marketing messages and visual concepts for the service
definition_of_done: Key messages and taglines drafted and documented
Initial visual direction and examples prepared
Messages reviewed by public relations manager for consistency

backlog.task: Prepare PR launch plan and media outreach strategy
definition_of_done: PR plan with channels, timing, and responsibilities documented
Draft press release and Q&A prepared
Legal and compliance review completed

backlog.task: Draft operational playbook for consultants delivering the service
definition_of_done: End-to-end delivery steps documented
Templates and checklists referenced and linked
Pilot consultants review and provide sign-off

backlog.task: Define data protection and compliance guidelines for using client data
definition_of_done: Data handling rules documented with legal input
Consent and disclosure requirements listed
Guidelines shared with all project stakeholders

backlog.task: Plan and coordinate a small pilot with selected SME clients
definition_of_done: Pilot client selection criteria defined
Pilot timeline and responsibilities agreed
Success metrics and feedback process documented

backlog.task: Create internal enablement materials for sales and support teams
definition_of_done: Slide deck or one-pager explaining the service created
FAQ section drafted with input from business consultant
Materials shared with sales and support leads

backlog.task: Align external messaging across marketing and PR channels
definition_of_done: Messaging matrix comparing channels and key points created
Conflicting claims or tones resolved with advertising manager
Final messaging set approved by senior management

backlog.task: Consolidate pilot learnings and propose post-launch improvements
definition_of_done: Pilot feedback from clients and internal teams collected
Findings summarized in a short report
List of prioritized improvements agreed with project team

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on service scope, target SMEs, and overall value proposition.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the SME advisory project and asking for scope alignment.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the initial service scope and target SME segments described in A1.
Confirm which use cases will be included in the first launch versus later phases.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on the financial and BI assessment framework and data requirements.
threads_plan.trigger: Accountant shares draft assessment checklist and asks for BI and compliance input.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off on the standard assessment checklist in A2 for pilot use.
Define minimum data quality and completeness criteria for accepting a client into the service.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize pricing, packaging, and commercial positioning for launch.
threads_plan.trigger: Business consultant posts draft pricing model and asks for feedback on tiers and margins.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the final pricing tiers and inclusions from A3 for the initial launch.
Agree on any introductory discounts or pilot-specific conditions.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align marketing and PR messaging and lock the launch plan.
threads_plan.trigger: Advertising manager shares draft messages and PR manager shares the launch plan.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final messaging matrix in A5 for all external channels.
Confirm the launch date and key PR activities in the PR plan.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot results and agree on improvements before broader rollout.
threads_plan.trigger: Business intelligence manager posts pilot summary and asks for improvement suggestions.

channel_rituals: Twice-weekly async check-in where each role posts progress on their top two tasks.
Weekly scope and risk review message led by the business consultant with quick reactions from others.
Dedicated thread after each pilot client engagement to log learnings and next steps.
Pre-launch readiness checklist review two days before go-live, confirming all artifacts are in place.
